remarks:
Charming Cape Cod, well-maintained 3-bedroom home offering comfortable first-floor living, classic character, and tremendous value! This 1,104 sq. ft. home features a first-floor primary bedroom and full bath, allowing it to easily function as a ranch-style home if desired. The inviting main level offers an open-concept living and dining area with beautiful hardwood floors, large picture windows, and a striking brick fireplace with raised hearth, creating a warm and welcoming space for everyday living or entertaining.
The updated kitchen provides modern convenience and functionality, while the second floor offers two additional bedrooms plus a versatile bonus space that could be used as a home office, playroom, hobby area, or additional storage. Step outside and enjoy the screened-in 3-season room, the perfect place to relax and enjoy the outdoors during the warmer months.
The full, clean and dry basement provides plenty of additional storage space, while the detached 2-car garage offers convenience and room for vehicles, tools, and outdoor equipment. The fully fenced yard provides a private outdoor space and sits on a quiet neighborhood street conveniently located near Hyde Park Golf Course and area amenities. All of this for under $160,000! A wonderful opportunity for a first-time buyer, downsizer, or anyone looking for a home with charm, flexibility, and plenty of value. Don't miss this one!
